description: Figure 5 is a line plot illustrating the performance of Dense Passage Retrieval (DPR) under four different expansion settings on the MS-Marco dev set, measured by MRR@10 on the y-axis against the number of queries used during inference (S) on the x-axis, which ranges from 1 to 10. The black solid line, labeled “DPR w/o query,” remains flat at approximately 34.5 across all values of S, indicating no change in performance. The red line with circle markers, “DPR w/ corpus expansion,” starts at about 35.1 when S=1 and steadily increases to approximately 35.8 at S=10. The green line with triangle markers, “DPR w/ document expansion,” begins near 34.8, peaks slightly above 35.0 at S=4, then gradually declines to about 34.9 at S=10. The blue line with diamond markers, “DPR w/ asymmetric expansion,” starts at 34.8, rises to a peak of about 35.0 at S=4, then declines steadily to approximately 34.4 at S=10. The plot shows that corpus expansion consistently improves performance as S increases, while document and asymmetric expansion show initial gains followed by declines or stagnation.
